note: How the lie of the land shows (core/game/game_relief.gd, drawn by ui/play/tile_view.gd, checked by tools/check_data.gd). Heights come from GameWorldGen; this only says how they look. A land tile is lit as if the sun stood in the north-west: a tile that rises to its east and south is brighter, one that falls away is darker (`slope_k` for each height of difference), and higher ground is lighter than low (`alt_gain` steps across `alt_span` heights above the sea, less `alt_mid` of that span). The sum is rounded to a step between -`steps` and `steps`, and a step is `step_gain` of brightness each. Water is flat: it is `deep` where the bed is `deep_depth` or more under the sea level, else shallow. Mountain ground at or above `snow_line` is snow.
